caption: Category Distribution of dataset
model_annotation: This pie chart illustrates the category distribution of a dataset, visually segmented into six distinct categories, each represented by a colored slice and labeled with its name, percentage, and absolute count. The largest segment is 'chat' at 41.2% (546,526), shown in red and occupying the majority of the chart. The second largest is 'math' at 21.9% (290,496), depicted in blue. Following these are 'tooluse' at 11.6% (154,358) in green, 'multi turn chat' at 9.3% (123,615) in orange, 'code' at 9.0% (119,563) in purple, and the smallest segment 'instruction follow' at 6.9% (91,460) in pink. The chart includes a legend in the top-left corner that maps each color to its corresponding category and count, and each slice also has its label and percentage directly annotated on the chart, with the slices arranged in descending order of size from left to right.
